items.title: More than half of physician disciplinary actions in California study involved gaps in medical knowledge
items.text: Gaps in medical knowledge, such as prescribing inappropriate medications, incorrectly interpreting imaging studies or ordering an unnecessary high-risk procedure that could jeopardize a patient's health, played a role in 52.3% of the physician disciplinary actions reviewed in a new American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) study published in the Journal of Continuing Education in the Health Professions.

items.title: ACAAI: Considerable delay seen from Rx to approval for children's biologics
items.text: There is a considerable delay from prescription of biologic therapy to final approval for pediatric patients, and almost 40% of prescriptions requiring a prior authorization (PA) are denied, according to a study presented at the annual meeting of the American College of Allergy, Asthma and Immunology, held from Nov. 12 to 16 in Phoenix.
